reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two separate bodies of literature—lattice misfit effects on creep in superalloys and the role of SRO in HEA deformation—into a single, dynamic mechanism where strain-driven SRO evolution at FCC/BCC interfaces governs progressive creep. No passage proposes this specific interplay, nor does any passage study creep in nanoscale FCC/BCC HEA multilayers with this mechanism.
